# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_WITH_VOLUME_CLIMAX_AND_RSI_EXTREME

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Gaps that occur on extreme RSI and a volume climax often reverse as liquidity is exhausted. We propose to fade these gaps by entering in the opposite direction of the gap at the close of the gap bar, with a chart stop at the opposite side of the gap and a trailing stop for the runner.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If the open gaps up >0.4% (open > prior close×1.004) AND RSI(14)>70 AND the gap bar's volume >2.5× the average volume of the prior 20 bars, enter short at the close of the gap bar; conversely, if the open gaps down >0.4% AND RSI<30 AND volume >2.5× average volume of the prior 20 bars, enter long at the close of the gap bar. Exit: Chart‑stop at the opposite side of the gap (stop at prior day's high for shorts, prior day's low for longs), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail using a 10% ATR trailing stop. Regime hint: Most effective in low‑mid VIX (<20) during the first 45 minutes after the open; avoid FOMC or major news days.
